positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Volunteer, Part-time 

Achievements:
- Led technical architecture and development of gaming news platform from scratch using Next.js, React.js, TypeScript, and Payload CMS.
- Conducted comprehensive CMS evaluation (WordPress vs. Payload), resulting in 40% reduction in database overhead and improved scalability.
- Designed and implemented role-based access control system with Admin/Editor/User permissions for secure content management workflows.
- Built scalable PostgreSQL database architecture, supporting thousands of articles and media files with optimized query performance.
- Created intuitive admin dashboard with rich text editor, live preview, and scheduled publishing, automating content creation for editors.
- Implemented automated media management system with image optimization, multiple size variants, and focal point cropping capabilities.
- Established CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions, Docker, and automated Trello-Discord integration for workflow management.
- Led stakeholder meetings and technical requirement gathering, translating business needs into technical specifications for non-technical team members.
- Mentored junior developers and created comprehensive documentation including setup guides, API docs, and development workflows.

Additional Achievements (Updated):
- Engineered dynamic content management system enabling editors to publish articles with rich contents, streamlined content workflows, and reduced time-to-publish.
- Established a comprehensive testing workflows using Vitest and SQLite, implementing unit tests across all data collections to ensure reliability and prevent production bugs.
- Built automated test using GitHub Actions to cover user authorization, media handling, and content management reducing manual testing time by 50% and enabling confident deployments.

projects.title: ThermaLink
projects.description:
ThermaLink is a Smart Room Climate Control System designed to provide independent temperature control for individual rooms based on the base temperature of the controlled room and set targeted within a multi-occupants living space. This was the final course project for the CSC 591 - Internet of Things (IoT) courses at North Carolina State University.

In this following project, I have an MQTT cloud network hosted through HiveMQ that serves as communication for the IoT devices and mobile application. The IoT devices is two ESP32s and a Raspberry Pi. One ESP32 will monitor the base (controlled) room temperature. The other ESP32, located in the experiment room, is responsible for interfacing with a connected heater and fan based on the given commands from messages via MQTT network. There will also be a Rasp Pi that monitors the experiment room temperature and detect occupancy presence in the room using OpenCV (Computer Vision) via a camera. All of the IoT devices are subscribed and publish to the MQTT network based on their roles.

For monitoring the system (i.e. temperature changes, person detection) and set manual controls (i.e. turns fan/heater on and off, set target temperature), there is a mobile application that provides easy interface to control the system. The mobile application is created using React Native, TypeScript. The backend API was implemented using Spring Boot, Java. The mobile application will subscribes to topics, monitoring temperature and occupancy detection. The mobile app will also publishes commands to MQTT for manual controls with IoT devices.

projects.title: Contribution to Fribbels Star Rail Optimizer, Web tools
projects.description:
Special thanks to Fribbels, the owner of the repository, and other contributors for making this website happened.

Backstory:
Wanted to contribute to an open-source project, I wanted to focused on projects that particularly interested me passionately. Thus, one of my favorite video game called Honkai Star Rail. This web application is similar to a toolkit, created to guide people through the game by providing accurate equipment and status calculation, communicate suggestions for improving your gameplay, and overall bring greater experience to players.

Key Contributions:
- Modified user interfaces experience and features implementation for providing suggestions to player's equipment status and optimizing them.
- Implemented complex data structures and filtering algorithms for computing optimal equipment status and sub-status to improving players' current characters.   
- Optimized probability distribution calculations and refined the Monte Carlo simulation to accurately predict resource requirements for winning their desired character upgrades.
- Documented comprehensive unit tests ensuring functionality integrity for resources prediction and probability calculation.

Edited: Have been stacked up on clients recently, so I will contribute when I am free.
